description: This source file appears to implement blame analysis functionality in a version control system, specifically for tracking line origins, managing blame data structures, and performing diff-based blame propagation. It involves interpreting commit history, line matching heuristics, and data structures for blame origins and entries.

classes.name: blame_scoreboard
classes.description: A data structure managing the blame analysis process, including the list of blame entries, blame origins, and associated metadata.

classes.name: blame_origin
classes.description: Represents the source of lines in blame analysis, including commit reference, file path, reference counts, fingerprints, and identifiers for line tracking.

classes.name: blame_entry
classes.description: Represents a grouped set of lines in blame results, with references to the suspect origin, line number, and additional metadata, forming a linked list for blame data.

classes.name: fingerprint
classes.description: A data structure representing line content signatures used for matching lines across different versions, implemented as a multiset of lower-cased byte pairs.

classes.name: fingerprint_entry
classes.description: Represents individual byte pair entries within a fingerprint, including their count.

classes.name: line_number_mapping
classes.description: Data structure used to map line numbers between different diff chunks, supporting linear transformations.

classes.name: blame_bloom_data
classes.description: Holds data related to bloom filters used for optimizing blame calculations, including keys and configuration.

classes.name: handle_split_cb_data
classes.description: Callback data used during blame splitting, holding references to blame origins and entries involved in a split operation.
